GAME INFO

RTP 96% MAX 10,000× 20 PAYLINES

BASE GAME

Wins pay from left to right across 20 paylines. Wild substitutes for all regular symbols except Scatter.

FREE SPINS

3 or more Scatter symbols trigger 10 Free Spins. Free Spin wins use a 2× multiplier.

BONUS BUY

Bonus Buy costs 100× the selected bet and immediately enters the Free Spins feature.
